scope: Replace the fixed homepage Editor's Pick visual with a six-article editorial carousel
contentSource: ProductContent.catalog article entries with explicit publication dates

behavior.initialSelection: Newest published article; stable editorial order for same-day ties
behavior.mobileImageFit: full-bleed cover in a shorter responsive 250-300px frame; left-anchored so excess is cropped from the right
behavior.overlayCaption: full-width bottom fade with one readable single-line article title
behavior.articleEntry: the whole visible image remains the article link beneath the non-interactive title fade
behavior.controlPlacement: independent strip below the image and above the discovery section
behavior.reducedMotion: automatic rotation starts paused and fades are disabled

verification.mobileControls: six bottom dots plus compact pause icon; arrows hidden
verification.desktopControls: bottom dots, compact pause icon and previous/next arrows

note: UXUI Pro Max informed touch targets, motion controls, focus behavior, alternative text and reduced-motion support.
